changeSet.comment: nexus-0rxvg: gc_quarantine_orphans_bounded registers its quarantine sibling from the origin's registered row (as hygiene-005-1 does for the unbounded form), not by parsing the sibling's name. An unregistered origin raises. Everything else in catalog-037-1's body is unchanged.

changeSet.author: nexus-0rxvg
changeSet.comment: nexus-0rxvg: one-off data correction for nexus.catalog_collections rows the catalog-037-1 body misregistered -- a quarantine-shaped row (prefix "quarantine-" or suffix "__quarantine") whose content_type carries a literal "quarantine-" prefix or the 'unknown' fallback. With a registered origin sibling every attribute is copied from it and lifecycle_state set to 'quarantine'; otherwise only the literal prefix is stripped. Same walk, same never-wedge shape (no RAISE path) and same RLS toggle as hygiene-005-3, which ran before catalog-037-1 existed. Idempotent: a corrected row no longer matches the walk. DATA EFFECT: UPDATEs catalog_collections.content_type / owner_id / embedding_model / model_version / dimension / lifecycle_state for quarantine-shaped rows the catalog-037-1 bounded sweep misregistered; irreversible, no rollback SQL (the corrected values are copied from a real sibling row or a deterministic prefix strip, not something to undo).
changeSet.sql: SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '5s'; LOCK TABLE nexus.catalog_collections IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
